description: Agent Accountability: submit an agent’s money and rail selection design: the instruments it can pay with, the filters the design names (legal protection, redemption risk, reversibility, liability, fee, speed, acceptance, limit) with when each is applied and what it reads, and the selection rule with its default. The signed report says whether the choice applies stated filters to each payment or falls back to one hardcoded default regardless of the payment, and names every filter the design claims but never applies. One payment task against money options is wever_money-fit-check. Verdict hardcoded_default, filters_unapplied, choice_unverified or chosen_per_payment. POST /api/money-choice-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-accountability-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-accountability/.

claimed.description: The design says it applies this filter.

instruments.description: What the agent can pay with.

kind.description: Such as stablecoin or agent card.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

default.description: The instrument used when no filter decides.
